candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and abbreviations commonly found in Hindi script and Indian proper nouns.
This vector is related to Hindi and Devanagari script subword tokens and romanized text fragments.
These tokens represent common Hindi conjunctions, relative pronouns, and conditional adverbs used to express time, place, and logical conditions.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi word suffixes and morphological endings.
This feature vector activates on Hindi punctuation marks and common dependent vowel sign combinations occurring at the ends of sentences.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi subword tokens and fragments starting with vowels or specific consonants.
These tokens represent characters, vowel-sign combinations, and sub-word units predominantly from the Devanagari script.
This vector activates for dependent vowel signs and punctuation marks in Indian scripts, specifically the Devanagari script.
This vector represents retroflex and dental plosive consonant characters and syllables in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel signs, dependent vowel modifiers, and frequent character combinations used in Devanagari script orthography.
